goal: Build all ~14 apps with representative content + working menus; keep Calculator/Terminal/Notes/TextEdit interactive in-session; each app self-registers with Dock/Launchpad/Spotlight and declares its menus.
summary:
Phase 3 complete — all 14 apps built, wired, and verified.

14 apps across 4 steps:
1. **Essential (6)**: Finder (sidebar+grid), Safari (chrome+start page), Notes (list+editor, interactive), Calculator (working state machine, div-by-zero→Error), Terminal (ls/pwd/echo/clear/help+history), System Settings (theme applies: dark mode/accent/wallpaper/reduce transparency).
2. **Productivity (4)**: Mail (inbox+message view, read-state), Calendar (month grid+events), Messages (interactive threads+send), TextEdit (rich text, bold/italic/underline).
3. **Media/utility (4)**: Music (player+cycling playlist), Photos (gradient grid), Maps (static+pins), Clock (world clock+timer).
4. **Verification**: 14 runtime tests (8 app + 5 overlay + 1 focus) all passing.

Mock data in src/data/: finder-data, notes-data, terminal-data, productivity-data (mail/calendar/messages), media-data (music/photos/clocks).

All wired into App.tsx renderApp switch (14 cases). Build green (462 modules), oxlint 0/0 (64 files), vitest 14/14.
